'''Esdras''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the master of [[Hiran Bessiker]], whom in [[3643 BBY]] Esdras sent to [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] to recover a [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] unearthed by the Republic.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Esdras is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Balmorra.
